abilityDefinitions.name: Cheap Shot
abilityDefinitions.description: Deals physical damage to one enemy and applies Bleed. Deals bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.

abilityDefinitions.name: Coward's Opening
abilityDefinitions.description: On first hit against a healthy enemy, gain temporary Critical Chance.

abilityDefinitions.name: Bone Bulwark
abilityDefinitions.description: Grants a Barrier and temporary Block chance.

abilityDefinitions.name: Rattle Guard
abilityDefinitions.description: On taking damage, has a chance to gain a defensive guard.

abilityDefinitions.name: Burning Mandibles
abilityDefinitions.description: Deals fire damage and applies Burn.

abilityDefinitions.name: Colony Heat
abilityDefinitions.description: On hit, has a small chance to refresh Burn duration and gain damage.

abilityDefinitions.name: Screech
abilityDefinitions.description: Deals low damage and disrupts the target's accuracy.

abilityDefinitions.name: Skittering Wings
abilityDefinitions.description: On dodge, gain temporary Attack Speed.

abilityDefinitions.name: Wraith Hex
abilityDefinitions.description: Applies Curse and deals shadow damage over time.

abilityDefinitions.name: Grave Whisper
abilityDefinitions.description: On enemy death, reduce cooldowns slightly.

abilityDefinitions.name: Sneak Attack
abilityDefinitions.description: Stab the target in the back, dealing {damage1} damage, and apply 8 bleed damage over 8 seconds.

abilityDefinitions.name: Pocket Dirt
abilityDefinitions.description: Whenever you dodge, use the opportunity to throw dirt at the target, decreasing their accuracy by 3% for 6 seconds

effects.log: {Actor} threw dirt in {Target}'s eyes. {Target}'s accuracy decreased by 3%.

abilityDefinitions.name: Raging Cleave
abilityDefinitions.description: Swing your weapon in a wide arc, dealing {damage1} damage to two enemies.

effects.log: {Target} received {Amount} damage.

abilityDefinitions.name: Reckless Assault
abilityDefinitions.description: Increase Attack Power by 20, but decrease Physical Defense by 20

effects.log: {Actor}'s Attack Power is increased by 20.
{Actor}'s Physical Defense is decreased by 20.

abilityDefinitions.name: Sniper's Strike
abilityDefinitions.description: Unleash a powerful shot dealing {damage1} damage. 50% increased critical chance.

effects.log: {Actor} landed a powerful shot on {Target}, dealing {Amount} damage.

abilityDefinitions.name: Poisoned Arrows
abilityDefinitions.description: Every ranged attack has a 20% chance to apply poison, dealing 6 damage over 3 seconds.

effects.log: {Actor} inflicted {Target} with poison from their ranged attack.

abilityDefinitions.name: Tail Wrap
abilityDefinitions.description: Apply a crushing force to the target, dealing {damage1} damage.

effects.log: {Target} received {Amount} damage.

abilityDefinitions.name: Big
abilityDefinitions.description: Health is increased by 50.

effects.log: {Actor}'s health is increased by 50 due to being big.

abilityDefinitions.name: Firebomb Toss
abilityDefinitions.description: Throw a flaming sphere, dealing {damage1} damage.

effects.log: {Target} received {Amount} damage.

abilityDefinitions.name: Hot Aura
abilityDefinitions.description: Enemies that attack you in melee range have a 30% chance to receive 4 burn damage.

effects.log: {Target} received {Amount} burn damage after attacking {Actor}.

abilityDefinitions.name: Ice Touch
abilityDefinitions.description: If the target has 5 stacks of Cold, apply Freeze for 4 seconds. Then remove 5 stacks of Cold.

abilityDefinitions.name: Cold Aura
abilityDefinitions.description: Enemies that attack you in melee range receive a Cold status effect that does not expire.

effects.log: {Target} has received 1 stack of Cold.

abilityDefinitions.name: Shadow Image
abilityDefinitions.description: Summon a shadow illusion of yourself with 1 health.

effects.log: {Actor} summoned a shadowy illusion of themselves.

abilityDefinitions.name: Shadowy Presence
abilityDefinitions.description: Increase chance of dodging by 2%.

effects.log: {Actor} moves with an elusive shadowy presence, increasing dodge chance by 2%.

abilityDefinitions.name: Bloodthirsty Fangs
abilityDefinitions.description: Deal {damage1} damage to the target, with 30% lifesteal.

effects.log: {Actor} bit {Target}, dealing {Amount} damage.

abilityDefinitions.name: Dark Vitality
abilityDefinitions.description: Whenever you heal through lifesteal, gain an extra 4 health.

effects.log: {Actor} gained an additional {Amount} health from lifesteal.

abilityDefinitions.name: Sweet Water
abilityDefinitions.description: Restores {heal1} Health to all allies every 2 seconds for 8 seconds.

effects.log: {Target} is soothed by {Actor}'s Sweet Water, restoring {Amount} health.

abilityDefinitions.name: Absorptive Shell
abilityDefinitions.description: Whenever you are attacked, reduce your cooldown pressure.

effects.log: {Actor}'s Absorptive Shell hastened their cooldown recovery.

abilityDefinitions.name: Mud Armor
abilityDefinitions.description: Decrease all damage taken by 2% for 6.5 seconds.

effects.log: {Actor} is covered in thick mud, reducing all damage taken by 2%.

abilityDefinitions.name: Earthly Fortitude
abilityDefinitions.description: Increase Physical Defense by 15.

effects.log: {Actor}'s body hardens like stone, increasing Physical Defense by 15.

abilityDefinitions.name: Acid Splash
abilityDefinitions.description: Apply poison to all enemies, dealing 12 damage over 9 seconds.

effects.log: {Actor} splashes corrosive acid onto all enemies.

abilityDefinitions.name: Corrosive Ooze
abilityDefinitions.description: Whenever damaged by a melee attack, apply poison to the target, dealing 6 damage over 12 seconds.

effects.log: {Actor} was attacked and coated {Target} with corrosive ooze.

abilityDefinitions.name: Unstable Colors
abilityDefinitions.description: 30% chance to apply a buff to everyone on your team, increasing Attack Power and Spell Power by 20 for 10 seconds.

effects.log: {Actor}'s colors ripple across {Target}, empowering them!

abilityDefinitions.name: Colorful Shield
abilityDefinitions.description: Whenever you use an ability, apply 20 Barrier to the ally with the highest Max Health.

effects.log: {Actor} creates a colorful shield around {Target}, granting 20 Barrier.

abilityDefinitions.name: Ignite Core
abilityDefinitions.description: Ignite and apply a fire aura to yourself. Deal 3 burn damage to everyone but you every second. Lasts 10 seconds.

abilityDefinitions.name: Fire Body
abilityDefinitions.description: Increase Fire Resistance by 5.

effects.log: {Actor}'s body hardens against fire, increasing Fire Resistance by 5.

abilityDefinitions.name: Transparent Engulf
abilityDefinitions.description: Trap a single enemy inside your body, stunning them for 3 seconds and dealing 9 damage over time.

effects.log: {Actor} engulfs {Target}, stunning and damaging them!

abilityDefinitions.name: Transparent Shift
abilityDefinitions.description: When below 30% health, increase dodge chance by 40% for 3 seconds. This effect can only be used once.

abilityDefinitions.name: Fae's Embrace
abilityDefinitions.description: Create a protective barrier around two allies, blocking up to 20 damage.

effects.log: {Target} received {Amount} barrier.

abilityDefinitions.name: Enchanted Charm
abilityDefinitions.description: Every 18 seconds, enemies have to resist your charms, or become stunned for 6 seconds.

abilityDefinitions.name: Ambush Strike
abilityDefinitions.description: Strike at the target, with 20% increased Crit Chance. Deal {damage1} damage.

effects.log: {Actor} swiped at {Target}, dealing {Amount} damage.

abilityDefinitions.name: Razor Claws
abilityDefinitions.description: Increase Critical Damage by 15%.

effects.log: {Target} has their critical damage increased by {Amount}.

abilityDefinitions.name: Distracting Illusion
abilityDefinitions.description: Create an illusion that has a chance to distract all enemies, reducing their accuracy by 10% for 5 seconds.

effects.log: {Target} has been distracted, reducing their accuracy.

abilityDefinitions.name: Foxfire Wisp
abilityDefinitions.description: Every 5 seconds, gain a Foxfire Wisp. When damaged, the attacker receives 8 magical damage and a stack is removed.

effects.log: A small wisp gathers around {Actor}.

abilityDefinitions.name: Necrotic Spores
abilityDefinitions.description: Release a burst of spores that reduce the natural regeneration of all enemies by 40% for 8 seconds.

effects.log: {Target} is afflicted by necrotic spores, weakening their regeneration.

abilityDefinitions.name: Twilight Bloom
abilityDefinitions.description: Produce a seed that blooms every 11 seconds, releasing a scent that heals your team.

effects.log: {Target} is soothed by the scent of the Twilight Bloom, restoring {Amount} health.

abilityDefinitions.name: Pixie Burst
abilityDefinitions.description: Deal {damage1} damage to all enemies.

effects.log: {Target} took {Amount} damage from {Actor}'s Pixie Burst.

abilityDefinitions.name: Resonant Chime
abilityDefinitions.description: Every time you use an ability, all allies gain +1 Crit Chance.

effects.log: {Target}'s crit chance increased by 1.

abilityDefinitions.name: Frenzy
abilityDefinitions.description: Increase Attack Speed by 24% and Critical Hit Chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

effects.log: {Actor}'s Attack Speed increased by 24%.
{Actor}'s Critical Chance increased by 25%.

abilityDefinitions.name: Savage Onslaught
abilityDefinitions.description: Increase Attack Power by 95 the first time dropping below 80% Health.

effects.log: {Actor}'s Attack Power is increased by 95 due to falling below 80% health.

abilityDefinitions.name: Feral Pounce
abilityDefinitions.description: Leap to a target, dealing 26 Physical Melee damage with a 30% chance to stun.

abilityDefinitions.name: Shredding Claws
abilityDefinitions.description: Every Melee attack has a 7% chance to apply 16 bleed damage over 4 seconds.

effects.log: {Target} is torn open by the {Actor}’s claws and begins to bleed.

abilityDefinitions.name: Plague Swipe
abilityDefinitions.description: Swipe at two nearby enemies, dealing {damage1} physical damage and applying 12 poison damage over 3 seconds.

abilityDefinitions.name: Pestilent Touch
abilityDefinitions.description: Melee attacks have a 17% chance to apply 15 poison damage over 6 seconds.

abilityDefinitions.name: Draining Claws
abilityDefinitions.description: Deal 31 Physical Melee damage to a target, reducing their Attack Power by 24 for 10 seconds.

abilityDefinitions.name: Vile Feast
abilityDefinitions.description: The first time anyone dies, eat their corpse and heal 100% of your Max Health. Can only occur once.

effects.log: {Actor} is healed to full health after devouring the corpse.

abilityDefinitions.name: Bone Arrow
abilityDefinitions.description: Use part of your bone as an arrowhead, dealing 20 physical ranged damage.

effects.log: {Actor} fired a bone arrow at {Target}, dealing {Amount} physical damage.

abilityDefinitions.name: Piercing Arrows
abilityDefinitions.description: All ranged attacks have a 15% chance to apply bleed, dealing 15 damage over 9 seconds.

effects.log: {Actor}'s arrow pierced {Target}, causing them to bleed.

abilityDefinitions.name: Siphon
abilityDefinitions.description: Deal 16 magic damage to the target.

effects.log: {Actor} siphoned energy from {Target}, dealing {Amount} magic damage.

abilityDefinitions.name: Protective Bone Barrier
abilityDefinitions.description: Every 10 seconds, form a barrier around you that can absorb up to 25 damage.

abilityDefinitions.name: Bone Shield
abilityDefinitions.description: Form a bone shield around you, reducing damage taken by 10% for 8 seconds.

effects.log: {Actor} summons a protective bone shield, reducing damage taken by 10%.

abilityDefinitions.name: Spiked Defense
abilityDefinitions.description: Whenever taking melee damage, reflect 6 damage to the attacker.

effects.log: {Target} is struck by {Actor}'s spiked bones for {Amount} damage.

essences.name: Goblin Ambusher Essence
essences.description: The stolen cunning of a goblin that strikes hardest when the enemy is exposed.

evolution.name: Pack Opportunist
evolution.description: Cheap Shot gains execute-style bonus damage against bleeding wounded enemies.

essences.name: Skeleton Guardian Essence
essences.description: A brittle sentinel's oath made durable through bone and spite.

evolution.name: Ossified Sentinel
evolution.description: Bone Bulwark also taunts the highest-threat enemy.

essences.name: Fire Ant Essence

evolution.name: Hiveflame Instinct
evolution.description: Burning Mandibles spreads a weaker Burn to another random enemy.

essences.name: Cave Bat Essence

evolution.name: Echo Hunter
evolution.description: Screech marks the target so the next hit deals bonus damage.

essences.name: Necroshade Wraith Essence
essences.description: A cold whisper that lingers after death and fattens on curses.

evolution.name: Hollow Dominion
evolution.description: Cursed enemies deal reduced damage and suffer more shadow damage.
